info.title: h42-mesh controller
info.summary: API of the h42-mesh controller (inventory, tunnels, agent configuration).

get.description: Liveness and database reachability, without authentication.

post.summary: Log in with username and password

post.description: Completes the login; the session gets a new token.
Deletes the session, if any, and clears the cookie (always succeeds).
Mandatory at first login. The other sessions of the user are closed.
Returns a new secret to show as a QR code; nothing is stored until confirmed.

post.summary: Confirm TOTP setup with a first code
post.description: Stores the secret, encrypted, once a code generated from it is verified.

get.summary: Find a user by exact username
get.description:
For mesh managers, to grant an access: returns only the id and username.

Allowed to the administrator and to users who manage at least one mesh.

post.description: The initial password is generated, returned once, and must be changed.

delete.description: Also deletes the mesh accesses, sessions and enrollment tokens of the user.

get.summary: List the meshes the user can access

post.description: Administrator, or users allowed to create meshes; the creator manages it.

delete.description: Refused while the mesh contains sites; its accesses are deleted with it.

get.summary: List the accesses to a mesh

put.summary: Grant or change the access of a user to a mesh

delete.summary: Remove the access of a user to a mesh

get.summary: List the sites of a mesh

delete.description: Refused while the site contains routers.

get.summary: List the routers of a site

delete.description: Also deletes its connections, tunnels, enrollment tokens, states and BGP routes.

get.summary: List the internet connections of a router
List the tunnels of a mesh

post.summary: Create an enrollment token for a router
post.description: Single use, valid a few hours, shown once. Previous unused tokens are deleted.

post.summary: Revoke the signing key of a router
post.description: The agent is refused from its next request on; a new enrollment lifts it.

post.summary: Enroll a router with a single-use token
post.description: The agent sends its new Ed25519 public key with the token; the token is used up.

put.description:
Authenticated with the current key; the new one replaces it, without history.

JWTs signed with the previous key are refused from the next request on.

get.description:
Site, connections and tunnels of the router, with the PSK of its tunnels only.

The ETag is the fingerprint: with the same fingerprint in If-None-Match,
the answer is 304 without a body.

post.summary: Discover the public address of a connection
post.description:
Sent through the connection itself, once per family.

The controller records the source address it sees, or the address forced
by the local configuration of the agent.

post.summary: Report the public key and port of tunnel ends of the router
post.description: All or nothing. A port is used once per router, all connections included.

put.summary: Report the state of the tunnels of the router (full snapshot)
put.description: Replaces every status reported by this router.

put.summary: Report the BGP table of the router (replaces the previous one)
put.description: Every known path, not only the best; no history is kept.
